versionStatus: REVIEW_CANDIDATE_NOT_ACTIVATED — 1.19.0 is the V4 Phase 5.3 local engineering round built on the 1.18.0 tree (schema 6 unchanged, no migration): Phase 5.3 adds the DETERMINISTIC candidate-ADJUDICATION report to the existing editorial path — the per-candidate identity-stance layer where ONLY the exact content-composite fingerprint equality (full_content_equality_observed) is identity-grade (stance exact_content_identity_observed, disposition reuse_locator_supported — an ECHO of the verified 5C-3 reuse path, never an executed merge) while every weaker similarity defers to review (identity_not_established_* with the explicit similarity_never_proves_identity reason); the report-level merge disposition under the versioned policy mp1 has a FIXED tested precedence: nothing observed → no_ground_no_candidates, incomplete coverage (probe overflow or report truncation) → defer_incomplete_coverage (the suppression policy adopted from the preserved sm1 proposal — an incomplete window never yields a merge proposal while the observed stances stay listed), ≥2 exact-identity candidates → defer_conflict_multiple_identity_candidates (a typed conflict record, never auto-picked), exactly 1 → reuse_locator_single_exact_identity (reviewRequired false), only weaker signals → defer_similarity_only (reviewRequired true); ambiguous or risky ⇒ review, NEVER a merge. The preserved unmerged sm1 threshold proposal (ADR-0051) was REVIEWED as a recorded design input: its suppression/ambiguity/weak-title concepts were adopted in honest form and its integer-threshold identity proposals were REJECTED (a score cutoff would claim identity from similarity, which the V4 directive forbids). The report rides inside drafts.document_json of the SAME fenced commit with ZERO new SQL statements, ZERO provider calls, ZERO cost; the flags OFF (shipped everywhere) keep the accepted path byte-identical; the adjudication gate NEVER implies the matching gate (payload produced only under BOTH; an honest warn is logged otherwise). All editorial/AI/ingestion/live gates stay OFF; Free readiness unchanged NOT_READY.
